q1_issues.issue: "at the full-moon meeting" is slotted as Location, but the meeting is an occasion (an eventuality witness), not a place — the instruction's own parallel ("in the final round" -> the preposition-named In, not During/Location) points to the surface-preposition oblique (At ...).

"during the following two weeks" is a frame window, but is encoded as (Measure sk_step_down_1 duration 2 week), which claims the stepping-down itself lasted two weeks; the anaphoric "following" ordering relative to the preceding narrative event is also dropped.
"returned to spring levels" gives a scalar-change endpoint a spatial Goal, which the Scalar change section explicitly forbids ("An end value is never a spatial Goal").

"The thread harvests returned to spring levels" is a definite plural with a distributive predicate but emits no per-member (Implication (PartOf $x sk_harvests_1) ...) rule, unlike the parallel plural subjects in statements 5 and 9.

(Measure sk_supply_1 duration 3 week) invents the scale `duration` — no word in "three weeks of supply" supplies a dimension, and the instruction reserves `unspecified` for an unstated scale; it also applies the eventuality-duration form to an entity witness.

"at the end of the winter" is encoded by minting an `end` entity witness (PartOf winter) and using it as the Time filler; Time takes structured calendar terms or bare deictic/named constants, never a minted witness.

(Cardinality sk_cats_1 (ParticleFromNormal 10 1)) puts a distribution in a slot the Cardinality section specifies as a native integer; ParticleFromNormal is licensed only for Measure-family magnitudes and clock-hour values.

q2_gaps: Forward window frame adverbial ("during the following two weeks") — WithinLast covers only backward windows, and the anaphoric "the following <unit>" rule increments a calendar term rather than framing a span, so a forward span has no licensed head.

Scalar-change endpoint stated as a qualitative level rather than a figure ("returned to spring levels") — MeasureTo requires a magnitude plus unit and Goal is barred for scalar endpoints, leaving no licensed form.
Period-relative time point ("at the end of the winter") — Time takes calendar terms or deictic/named constants, and Start/End attach to an eventuality's own extent, not to a separate period NP.
Approximate cardinality ("about ten sky-cats") — Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase covers only vague quantities with no number, so a hedged exact count has no licensed form.
Attributive comparative with elided standard ("a heavier distillation cycle") — the instruction set itself directs dropping it and recording the gap; the parse correctly drops it.
Measure/quantity of-phrase ("three weeks of supply") — named only as an exclusion from the genitive rule, with no positive encoding given.
Deadline "by <event-noun>" ("by the spring equinox") — TimeAtMost takes calendar terms only, and Before is strict precedence, so the inclusive "at or before" sense has no carrier.
Ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 210 of Year 1") — (Day <n>) is defined as a bare granularity term with no day-of-month vs day-of-year distinction.
notes: Strong on the mechanical rules — compound genus/modifier exposure, the capitalized-common-noun vs Name split, the copular-plus-time dual-emit, the plural reified-state plus per-member rule, and the stative-transitive Agent for "held" all match the instruction set exactly. Treating "the spring equinox came" as a light verb over an event-noun (tense and Time straight on sk_equinox_1, no `come` event) extends a rule whose stated examples are occurred/happened/took place; defensible but not literally licensed.
